summary: Iteration 14 - Complete testing of bug fixes and new features. 10/10 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI elements verified via Playwright screenshots. Monitoring stats correctly show 12 total (including device-synced generators). Device Parts (Ersatzteile) CRUD working with type dropdown. Service Plan maintenance form has both months AND hours mandatory. ATS and Diagnosis sections use 3-state buttons. Lasttest table header says 'Lasttest' not 'Messwerte'. Create plan modal opens for devices without plans and auto-navigates to plan detail after creation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 14 complete. All reported bugs verified as fixed: (1) Monitoring stats show 12 total including virtual generators from devices, (2) Maintenance entries save with both months AND hours mandatory fields, (3) Devices without plan can open create modal which auto-navigates to detail. New features verified: Parts/Ersatzteile CRUD per device, ATS/Diagnosis 3-state buttons (nicht_durchgefuehrt/durchgefuehrt/nicht_vorhanden), Lasttest table header says 'Lasttest'.
